name: hgi_seq_v2-v24-acb7765d9
purpose: ot_hgi_seq v2.4 (CP.FETCH prefetching sequencer, cycle-identical to v2.3 on the 43-case bench): v2.3 route 8447139d1 TT -48.25 (run_q -> be_inj -> pop count pc -> 1.5k FIFO data flops, 22-24 lv, pc ~4.6k selects) fixed structurally by a LAZY-SHIFT FIFO (storage lags the view by the registered pop count, replicated per entry/reader; fq_th moved by a 5-way shift select); FF -15.5 (flop->ring macro wd/we, input pins) by 2 kept HB4 stages on inputs and macro write data/enables; M5 layer cap; main flow fixes (hold measured after parasitics)
